Captured from an HGST HUH721010AL4200 (smartctl 7.5) that reports SMART health
OK while having failed its own long self-test.  Kept as a fixture because the
report's SAS section is built entirely from these two blocks, and a change to
smartmontools' layout would silently empty it again.
